== Description ==
'''LAPSE-3''' is one of the many [[Alpha & Shadowpocalypse]] exclusive Entities, it's the Lapse variant of [[SHA-3]].

== Behavior ==
'''LAPSE-3''' will spawn in the center of the room upon opening the door, and after a few seconds he will rush forward and break 8 doors instead of 10 like SHA-3. Meaning that the void wall will catch up to you directly, but you won't ''need'' to progress any rooms to prevent death. Once LAPSE-3 reaches the main room, it will wait for the player to reach the main room and repeat the process a few times, each time having a chance to spawn entities.

== Strategies & Tips ==
* Since '''LAPSE-3''' waits for you to reach the main room before repeating its cycle, you should recover your stamina before entering the room.
* '''LAPSE-3''' can spawn entities when it breaks the door, so be careful and deal with them first, no need to wary about '''LAPSE-3''' at the moment, since it will wait for you to enter the room it is in before breaking doors again.

== Trivia ==
* '''LAPSE-3''' was meant to be added to the game during [[Perfection Event 3/13/26]], but was left out, instead being added in "Update Executive".
